subject: science
concept: Understanding that Earth's resources (water, soil, air) need to be used responsibly
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Human Activity Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts examples into 'wastes resources' and 'uses resources responsibly' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a resource to a responsible way of using it
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a specific resource needs to be used carefully

misconception_flags: assumes a resource like water is unlimited and doesn't need care

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
